chunks: And it is narrated: “Whoever vows to walk barefoot to the House of Allah should walk; then if he becomes tired, he may ride.”

key_terms.بَيْتِ اللَّهِ: the House of Allah, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.رَكِبَ: rode a mount or means of transport

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on someone who vows to walk barefoot to the House of Allah and then becomes tired?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a vow to walk barefoot to the House of Allah. It indicates that the person should fulfill the vow by walking, but if exhaustion overtakes him, riding is permitted.
